# proxmox_storage_file_download (Resource)

Downloads an ISO, LXC template, or import image into Proxmox storage through `/nodes/{node}/storage/{storage}/download-url`, waits for the task, and manages the resulting storage content item.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0

resource "proxmox_storage_file_download" "debian_iso" {
  node                = "pve-1"
  storage             = "local"
  content             = "iso"
  filename            = "debian-13.0.0-amd64-netinst.iso"
  url                 = "https://cdimage.debian.org/debian-cd/current/amd64/iso-cd/debian-13.0.0-amd64-netinst.iso"
  checksum            = "replace-with-sha256"
  checksum_algorithm  = "sha256"
  verify_certificates = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `content` (String) Storage content type: `iso`, `vztmpl`, or `import`. Changes require replacement.
- `filename` (String) Destination filename. Use only letters, numbers, dots, underscores, and hyphens. Changes require replacement.
- `node` (String) Proxmox node that performs the download. Changes require replacement.
- `storage` (String) Destination storage identifier. Changes require replacement.
- `url` (String, Sensitive) HTTP or HTTPS URL to download. Stored in Terraform state. Changes require replacement.

### Optional

- `checksum` (String) Expected file checksum. Must be set together with `checksum_algorithm`. Changes require replacement.
- `checksum_algorithm` (String) Checksum algorithm: `md5`, `sha1`, `sha224`, `sha256`, `sha384`, or `sha512`. Changes require replacement.
- `compression` (String) Compression algorithm used to decompress the download. Changes require replacement.
- `verify_certificates` (Boolean) Verify TLS certificates. Proxmox defaults to true. Changes require replacement.

### Read-Only

- `format` (String) Downloaded storage content format.
- `id` (String) Identifier in `node/storage/volume_id` form.
- `notes` (String) Storage content notes.
- `path` (String) Server-side path of the downloaded file.
- `protected` (Boolean) Storage content protection status when supported.
- `size` (Number) File size in bytes.
- `used` (Number) Reported used bytes.
- `volume_id` (String) Proxmox volume identifier of the downloaded file.
